modifier.description: The Access Modifier of the generated designer class: `internal` (ResXFileCodeGenerator), `public` (PublicResXFileCodeGenerator) or `none` (no code generation, no designer file).

designer.description: The designer file written or deleted.

status.description: written (the project item and the designer file), unchanged, pending (sent off the UI thread or awaiting review), error (`message`: no host, no project lists the file, a legacy project the host cannot edit).
